Description: “Live action” describes a wide range of activities, from sports, to real-time roleplaying, to playground/party games. Careful choices about mechanics, abstraction, and communication help create an engaging experience without physical or emotional harm.

Instructors/speakers: Philip Tan, Jason Begy
title: Lecture 32: Live Action Games

MIT CMS.608 Game Design, Fall 2010
Instructors: Philip B. Tan, Jason Begy

"Live action" describes a wide range of activities, from sports, to real-time roleplaying, to playground/party games. Careful choices about mechanics, abstraction, and communication help create an engaging experience without physical or emotional harm.
